purpose: Overlay Wave 6 lifecycle and maintenance-recovery evidence onto the Book quantitative coverage map while keeping practitioner case evidence distinct from peer-reviewed studies.

overlays.newEditorialCapability: Teach the full maintenance chain: flow/pressure/temperature evidence -> contamination or imbalance hypothesis -> intervention -> post-intervention hydraulic/production verification.
overlays.boundary: Practitioner cases provide useful before/after observations but do not define universal flow, pressure-drop or cleaning thresholds.

overlays.newEditorialCapability: Connect mould components and cooling circuits to long-term degradation, cleaning/refurbishment and observable part-metrology consequences.
Distinguish short-cycle process monitoring from long-horizon asset-condition monitoring and intervention verification.
Add measured sequential valve-gate pressure/flow chronology to the newer valve-pin pressure-control evidence from Wave 5.
Show that dimensional drift can originate from both process thermal imbalance and long-term mould condition, requiring different evidence and interventions.
